verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the dot keeps its own notes about preferences, decisions, and ongoing work so it can use them in later conversations (dots-docs-23). Its memory persists across ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, and calls (dots-docs-5), and it applies past context, for example flagging a conflict with a draft shared last week (dots-docs-24). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of memory recall, and documentation of how a user can view, edit, or scope what the dot remembers.
